title: Read and write a bounded local text file; handle a missing file and failed write
explanation: File operations can fail because of permissions or missing paths. Use a fixed private directory and check return values. For uploads, validate the upload error, size and detected MIME type, choose a generated name and keep content outside the public document root.
kurdish: بۆ فایل ڕێڕەوی دیاریکراو بەکاربهێنە و شکستی نووسین بپشکنە. ناو و جۆری فایلە نێردراوەکە بە تەنها بەڵگەی پارێزراوی نییە.
guided: Read and write a bounded local text file; handle a missing file and failed write.
task: Write a note containing network; reload it.
expected: The note persists as literal text. Missing CSRF fails. An empty note is allowed.

title: Process an image upload with size, MIME and extension checks and a generated storage name
explanation: File operations can fail because of permissions or missing paths. Use a fixed private directory and check return values. For uploads, validate the upload error, size and detected MIME type, choose a generated name and keep content outside the public document root.
kurdish: بۆ فایل ڕێڕەوی دیاریکراو بەکاربهێنە و شکستی نووسین بپشکنە. ناو و جۆری فایلە نێردراوەکە بە تەنها بەڵگەی پارێزراوی نییە.
guided: Process an image upload with size, MIME and extension checks and a generated storage name.
task: Upload a valid PNG, then a text file renamed to .png.
expected: PNG succeeds; disguised text fails with 422. Check generated storage names.

title: Create a database and tables in phpMyAdmin; inspect types, keys and relationships
explanation: A relational database stores records in tables with explicit types and keys. Begin by inspecting a small schema. PDO connects PHP to the database using configuration kept outside public responses. A failed connection should show a generic message while details stay in a private log.
kurdish: داتابەیس بە خشتە و کلیل ڕێکدەخرێت. زانیاریی پەیوەندی لە ناوەڕۆکی گشتی دەرنەخە؛ هەڵەی سێرڤەر بۆ بەکارهێنەر چاپ مەکە.
guided: Create a database and tables in phpMyAdmin; inspect types, keys and relationships.
task: Import into a fresh classroom database and inspect network_devices.
expected: A device referencing an unknown student fails its foreign key constraint.

title: Enable the required extension and establish a configured PDO connection
explanation: A relational database stores records in tables with explicit types and keys. Begin by inspecting a small schema. PDO connects PHP to the database using configuration kept outside public responses. A failed connection should show a generic message while details stay in a private log.
kurdish: داتابەیس بە خشتە و کلیل ڕێکدەخرێت. زانیاریی پەیوەندی لە ناوەڕۆکی گشتی دەرنەخە؛ هەڵەی سێرڤەر بۆ بەکارهێنەر چاپ مەکە.
guided: Enable the required extension and establish a configured PDO connection.
task: Set the documented environment and provision a synthetic operator.
expected: Sign-in works. A wrong password fails; missing database settings do not expose configuration.

title: Compare unsafe SQL construction with bound values in a prepared lookup
explanation: Prepared statements separate SQL structure from supplied values. Bind data rather than concatenating it into the SQL. Parameters cannot stand in for column names: sort choices require an allowlist. Bound the number of records returned and define a stable order.
kurdish: SQL لە نرخەکان جیا بکەرەوە. ناوی ستوون بە parameter ناگۆڕدرێت؛ بۆ ڕیزکردن allowlist و بۆ ئەنجامەکان سنوور دابنێ.
guided: Compare unsafe SQL construction with bound values in a prepared lookup.
task: Search for a name containing a quotation mark.
expected: Prepared values remain data and the schema stays intact.

title: Build bounded SELECT and LIKE queries and allowlist a sort choice
explanation: Prepared statements separate SQL structure from supplied values. Bind data rather than concatenating it into the SQL. Parameters cannot stand in for column names: sort choices require an allowlist. Bound the number of records returned and define a stable order.
kurdish: SQL لە نرخەکان جیا بکەرەوە. ناوی ستوون بە parameter ناگۆڕدرێت؛ بۆ ڕیزکردن allowlist و بۆ ئەنجامەکان سنوور دابنێ.
guided: Build bounded SELECT and LIKE queries and allowlist a sort choice.
task: Search with q=edge and sort=gpa, then an unsupported sort choice.
expected: Results are bounded; unsupported sorting uses the fixed full_name fallback.

title: Rebuild a validated form and database listing from a short brief
explanation: Use the request lifecycle as a debugging map: receive input, validate it, execute a query and render escaped output. Isolate failures at each stage. A missing table, wrong parameter and duplicate email are different errors with different remedies.
kurdish: کێشەکە هەنگاو بە هەنگاو بدۆزەوە: input، validation، query و output. پێش گۆڕینی کۆد بەڵگەی هەڵەکە تۆمار بکە.
guided: Rebuild a validated form and database listing from a short brief.
task: Recreate the fields and listing from the supplied brief.
expected: The reference implementation validates fields and escapes database output.

title: Diagnose connection, parameter, column-name and constraint failures
explanation: Use the request lifecycle as a debugging map: receive input, validate it, execute a query and render escaped output. Isolate failures at each stage. A missing table, wrong parameter and duplicate email are different errors with different remedies.
kurdish: کێشەکە هەنگاو بە هەنگاو بدۆزەوە: input، validation، query و output. پێش گۆڕینی کۆد بەڵگەی هەڵەکە تۆمار بکە.
guided: Diagnose connection, parameter, column-name and constraint failures.
task: Compare a stopped database, wrong password and misspelled column in a disposable copy.
expected: Use server logs to identify the different causes; return a generic browser error.

title: Create student records using validation, INSERT and Post-Redirect-Get
explanation: Create records only after validation, using prepared INSERT statements. Redirect after a successful POST to reduce accidental resubmission on refresh. List records in a stable order and preserve search parameters when changing pages. Handle empty results explicitly.
kurdish: دوای POST ـی سەرکەوتوو redirect بکە. لیست و گەڕان دەبێت ڕیزبەندیی جێگیر و پەیامی دۆخی بەتاڵیان هەبێت.
guided: Create student records using validation, INSERT and Post-Redirect-Get.
task: Create a student, then repeat its email address.
expected: The first INSERT persists. The duplicate fails without a raw SQL message.

title: List and search database records; add bounded pagination and an empty state
explanation: Create records only after validation, using prepared INSERT statements. Redirect after a successful POST to reduce accidental resubmission on refresh. List records in a stable order and preserve search parameters when changing pages. Handle empty results explicitly.
kurdish: دوای POST ـی سەرکەوتوو redirect بکە. لیست و گەڕان دەبێت ڕیزبەندیی جێگیر و پەیامی دۆخی بەتاڵیان هەبێت.
guided: List and search database records; add bounded pagination and an empty state.
task: Create at least 21 synthetic records and navigate to page 2.
expected: A page contains at most 20 rows and the ordering stays stable.

title: Load an existing record into an edit form and perform a validated UPDATE
explanation: An edit flow loads one identified record, validates changes and updates only that record. Deletion is a state-changing action: use POST, verify a CSRF token and recheck permission. Invalid identifiers and missing records need clear, defined responses.
kurdish: تەنها تۆماری هەڵبژێردراو بگۆڕە. سڕینەوە بە GET مەکە؛ CSRF و مۆڵەت لەسەر سێرڤەر دووبارە بپشکنە.
guided: Load an existing record into an edit form and perform a validated UPDATE.
task: Open two edit forms and save the older one second.
expected: The stale update receives 409 and does not overwrite the newer record.

title: Add confirmation, POST-based deletion and CSRF checking; compare soft and hard deletion
explanation: An edit flow loads one identified record, validates changes and updates only that record. Deletion is a state-changing action: use POST, verify a CSRF token and recheck permission. Invalid identifiers and missing records need clear, defined responses.
kurdish: تەنها تۆماری هەڵبژێردراو بگۆڕە. سڕینەوە بە GET مەکە؛ CSRF و مۆڵەت لەسەر سێرڤەر دووبارە بپشکنە.
guided: Add confirmation, POST-based deletion and CSRF checking; compare soft and hard deletion.
task: Cancel a deletion prompt, then confirm a deletion with a valid token.
expected: Cancel leaves data unchanged. Confirm hides one student; missing token fails.

title: Store password hashes and verify credentials; demonstrate reflected and stored XSS prevention
explanation: Security is part of the normal request flow. Store password hashes, encode dynamic HTML and require nonempty CSRF tokens on protected changes. Test missing, malformed and wrong-session tokens and verify that rejected requests change no records.
kurdish: پاراستن بە ناوی function تەواو نابێت؛ بە input ـی هەڵە تاقی بکەرەوە و دڵنیابە داواکاریی ڕەتکراو هیچ داتایەک ناگۆڕێت.
guided: Store password hashes and verify credentials; demonstrate reflected and stored XSS prevention.
task: Verify a wrong password returns false; display script markup as literal text.
expected: true, then literal script markup as text. The generated hash changes between runs.

title: Generate and verify nonempty CSRF tokens; recheck permission on protected POST actions
explanation: Security is part of the normal request flow. Store password hashes, encode dynamic HTML and require nonempty CSRF tokens on protected changes. Test missing, malformed and wrong-session tokens and verify that rejected requests change no records.

guided: Generate and verify nonempty CSRF tokens; recheck permission on protected POST actions.
task: Submit a valid token, remove it, then submit csrf[] instead.
expected: Valid token succeeds. Missing or array-shaped token gives 403 without a database change.

title: Split reusable code into config, functions, header and footer files
explanation: Split repeated configuration, helper functions and page fragments into predictable files. Use __DIR__ for paths and require_once for mandatory helpers. Keep the request flow readable without introducing a framework or a new architectural pattern.
kurdish: فایلەکان بە بەرپرسیارییەتیی ڕوون جیا بکەرەوە؛ ئامانج ئاسانکردنی تێگەیشتنە، نەک زیادکردنی ئاڵۆزی.
guided: Split reusable code into config, functions, header and footer files.
task: Add a third device and change the shared footer; check the layout is included once.
expected: One shared heading, two device names and one shared footer.

explanation: Split repeated configuration, helper functions and page fragments into predictable files. Use __DIR__ for paths and require_once for mandatory helpers. Keep the request flow readable without introducing a framework or a new architectural pattern.

guided: Separate the header, footer, configuration and escaping helper into fixed files.
task: Build two pages that share one header without copying its markup.
expected: Both pages show the same header after one edit.

title: Validate a new registration form
explanation: Revisit forms using a new dataset. Write the rules first, then test valid, missing, empty, array-shaped and out-of-range values. Explain why each rejected case fails before comparing your solution with the reference.

guided: Create a registration form with required scalar name, email and stage fields.
task: Reject array input and stages outside 1–4; preserve safe valid values.
expected: Invalid fields show messages and no data is saved.

title: Rebuild a flash-message flow
explanation: Rebuild the protected-page flow from memory. Separate authentication from permission to change a particular record. Test in two browser sessions and verify logout and cross-user access rather than relying on a successful happy-path login.
kurdish: بە دوو session تاقی بکەرەوە؛ چوونەژوورەوە واتە مۆڵەتی دەستکاریی هەموو داتا نییە.
guided: Show a one-time success message using session state.
task: Make the message appear once after a redirect and disappear on refresh.
expected: The message is consumed exactly once.

title: Test ownership and logout
explanation: Rebuild the protected-page flow from memory. Separate authentication from permission to change a particular record. Test in two browser sessions and verify logout and cross-user access rather than relying on a successful happy-path login.
kurdish: بە دوو session تاقی بکەرەوە؛ چوونەژوورەوە واتە مۆڵەتی دەستکاریی هەموو داتا نییە.
guided: Check permission before every protected update or delete.
task: Try a record owned by another user and verify logout removes access.
expected: Rejected actions leave records unchanged.

title: Build your student project incrementally
explanation: Combine the familiar PHP building blocks into one local application. Start with the schema and a minimal listing, then add creation, editing and safe deletion. Make one small change at a time and retest earlier features after each addition.
kurdish: پڕۆژەکە پارچە بە پارچە بنیات بنێ. دوای هەر زیادکردنێک بەشە پێشووترەکان تاقی بکەرەوە تا هەڵەی نوێ دروست نەبێت.
guided: Integrate forms, PDO, sessions and shared PHP files in a local student records application.
task: Build the list and create flows first, then add edit and delete.
expected: Each feature has a recorded valid and invalid case.

title: Peer review and repair your project
explanation: Combine the familiar PHP building blocks into one local application. Start with the schema and a minimal listing, then add creation, editing and safe deletion. Make one small change at a time and retest earlier features after each addition.
kurdish: پڕۆژەکە پارچە بە پارچە بنیات بنێ. دوای هەر زیادکردنێک بەشە پێشووترەکان تاقی بکەرەوە تا هەڵەی نوێ دروست نەبێت.
guided: Give a classmate your setup notes and observe where they get stuck.
task: Repair three reported issues and repeat the original successful cases.
expected: A second person can run the local project and explain its core flow.

title: Independent reconstruction challenge
explanation: Use a blank project and a short brief to demonstrate independence. Explain how a request becomes validated data, a database operation and an HTML response. Keep a record of unresolved defects and repeat the task later with different inputs.
kurdish: پێوەری تێگەیشتن ئەوەیە بتوانیت بەبێ کۆپی بنووسیت و هۆکاری هەر هەنگاوێک ڕوون بکەیتەوە. تەواوکردنی پەڕە بە تەنها بەس نییە.
guided: Rebuild a validated student form and protected database listing from a short brief.
task: Use a blank folder; consult documentation but do not copy a finished implementation.
expected: The application validates, persists and displays records safely.

title: Explain your code and plan your next practice
explanation: Use a blank project and a short brief to demonstrate independence. Explain how a request becomes validated data, a database operation and an HTML response. Keep a record of unresolved defects and repeat the task later with different inputs.
kurdish: پێوەری تێگەیشتن ئەوەیە بتوانیت بەبێ کۆپی بنووسیت و هۆکاری هەر هەنگاوێک ڕوون بکەیتەوە. تەواوکردنی پەڕە بە تەنها بەس نییە.
guided: Demonstrate success, empty, invalid and unauthorised cases in the final project.
task: Explain request → validation → query → escaped output and identify one improvement.
expected: Source, local setup notes and a test evidence sheet are complete.
